# SBC decoder

Android's SBC decoder (Open Interface North America / The Android Open Source Project), Apache License 2.0
(full text in [LICENSE](LICENSE)).
Copied unmodified from
https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/modules/Bluetooth/+/refs/heads/main/system/embdrv/sbc/decoder
(`include/` and `srce/`). Used for sources that only offer SBC, see `src/SinkSession.m`.
